About the Scholarship

Cambridge Trust International Scholarships support highly ranked overseas PhD applicants. Selection focuses on academic ability and research potential rather than the applicant’s financial circumstances. University of Cambridge is seeking candidates for this PhD opportunity focused on Cambridge Trust International Scholarship at University of Cambridge 2027. Research areas covered include All Subjects. The host institution is in Cambridge, United Kingdom. According to the listing, this is a fully funded opportunity; financial support is listed as Stipend/salary rate set by the funder — see the official listing. Timing: Your Cambridge course funding deadline.

Research Areas

  • Eligible subjects across the university

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
FundingInternational tuition, annual maintenance, student visa and Immigration Health Surcharge.
MaintenanceAnnual maintenance sufficient for a single student
DurationAs specified in the award

Eligibility and Requirements

Applicants from countries other than the UK or Ireland, highly ranked by their department; premium-rate courses excluded. English evidence, approved equivalents and waivers depend on the programme; IELTS is not a universal requirement for every applicant.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
RecruitmentCourse-specific recruitment
DeadlineYour Cambridge course funding deadline

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://apply.postgraduate.study.cam.ac.uk/applicant/login

Source: apply.postgraduate.study.cam.ac.uk - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Your Cambridge course funding deadline - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Submit a Cambridge admission application by the relevant funding deadline and complete the funding section. No separate scholarship application.

Selection considers academic ability, examination results, references and research potential.

About University of Cambridge

The University of Cambridge offers research degrees across a wide range of subjects. Doctoral applicants apply through its postgraduate portal and may be considered for university, college and partner funding.
